Northern Telecom Inc was the equipment provider to Canada's telephone companies. It was owned by Bell Canada enterprises for much of its history. In the late '90s and into the 2000s, they got heavy on the networking business and to accelerate that effort purchased Bay Networks.

t: Nortel Networks Corporation | Encyclopedia.com
s: In January the company paid US$3.25 billion in stock for Boca Raton, Florida-based Qtera Corporation, producer of long-distance optical networking systems. Two months later Nortel completed two acquisitions: the US$2.1 billion purchase of San Jose-based Clarify, Inc., which specialized in customer relationship management software used in Internet communications; and the US$778 million buyout of Fremont, California-based Promontory Communications, Inc.
